capabilities: View statblocks using multiple game-system layouts
extras: README is a stub: full documentation lives on a separate site; it is mostly license disclosures (Wizards of the Coast, Fire Opal Media, Paizo, Critical Role/Darrington Press). Warns that bugs may delete data and recommends automated backups.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to build or display tabletop RPG creature statblocks or a monster compendium.
summary: Bestiary manager that creates, stores, and renders D&D-style creature statblocks in an Obsidian vault.
